verdict.rationale: AI explanations of failed commands are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some terminals ship built-in AI assistance, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows WezTerm offering AI explanations or suggested fixes. Shell integration, Lua event callbacks and the CLI are developer building blocks a user could wire to an external AI, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI explanations and suggested fixes when a command fails
